title: Calorie target
summary: A base daily budget, with corrections to single days.
description: Settings holds a base budget for every day. A single day can be corrected ("I overate yesterday, take 200 off today") so that room moves between days inside a week.

stories.want: to take the difference off the next days
stories.soThat: the week still comes out level

requirements.text: A day's target is the base budget plus that day's correction; a correction applies to its own day only.
A multi-day period's target is the base budget times its days; corrections do not change it.
A correction is at most `goal.max-correction` either way.
A day's target never falls below `goal.min-target`.
Tally has no achievements or rewards tied to staying under a daily calorie budget.
